# Eval tokens and steps: 0.8.0 and main

One full graded run of each tree, same 7 cases, producer `composer-2.5`, graders `grok-4.6`.

The suite total falls from 14.04M tokens to 4.73M (−66%). That drop is the graders. The producer, which is the skill and CLI a user run pays for, stays near 2.7M tokens (−4%). Producer steps fall from 21 to 14 (−33%). Producer tool calls fall from 128 to 106 (−17%).

`main` is `94cb448`. `package.json` there is still `0.8.0`. This is the tree that would ship in the next release. The previous release is `4167e5f` (`0.8.0`).

## Method

Both runs are `pnpm eval` with graders on: one producer and two graders (grouping, prose) per case. Tokens are `usage.totalTokens` from the Cursor SDK, which equals input + cache read + output. A step is one assistant message from the SDK `onStep` callback. Tool calls are counted separately. One assistant message can issue many tool calls.

| | 0.8.0 | main |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Commit | [`4167e5f`](https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende/commit/4167e5f) | [`94cb448`](https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende/commit/94cb448) |
| When | 2026-09-22, local | 2026-09-22, [Actions run 35730203593](https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende/actions/runs/35730203593) |
| Skill tree | `b90033d0755d` | `5007e648d0bc` |
| `validate` | exit 0 on all 7 | exit 0 on all 7 |

0.8.0 did not record steps. This run added the same counter `main` uses (assistant messages and tool calls) and left the prompt, skill, CLI, and graders as they were in that release.

Two harness differences sit in these numbers:

- The 0.8.0 producer prompt says the CLI named in the skill is the local build. The `main` prompt names `node <abs>/dist/cli/main.js` and tells the agent that command is already built. Any CLI search that sentence causes sits in the 0.8.0 producer totals.
- Graders on `main` get the grading packet inline and are told to start from it. 0.8.0 graders do not. Grader tokens are eval cost. They are not part of the published package.

The skill and CLI also differ. 0.8.0 tells the agent to run `index`, read the JSON Schema, and write `review.json` across separate commands. `main` writes a covering skeleton with `review`, batches the shell commands, uses `references/example.md` for the shape, and writes `review.json` once. Lockfiles have no hunk refs.

`validate` passed on every case in both runs. The 0.8.0 run missed deterministic expects in its own case files (`why`, `parts`, `together` on several cases). The `main` run passed its expects. Those expects were edited after 0.8.0. Prose lint does not fail the run.

## Suite

| | 0.8.0 | main | Change |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Tokens | 14,039,185 | 4,730,610 | −66.3% |
| Producer tokens | 2,776,563 | 2,653,514 | −4.4% |
| Producer steps | 21 | 14 | −33.3% |
| Producer tool calls | 128 | 106 | −17.2% |
| Grader tokens | 11,262,622 | 2,077,096 | −81.6% |
| Grader steps | 71 | 27 | −62.0% |

Producer token split:

| | 0.8.0 | main | Change |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Input | 1,480,766 | 1,458,125 | −1.5% |
| Cache read | 1,253,248 | 1,153,248 | −8.0% |
| Output | 42,549 | 42,141 | −1.0% |

Output stays about 1.5% of producer tokens. Almost all of the producer cost is context sent again on the next call.

## How to read one run

`composer-2.5` moves a lot between runs of the same skill. The [token efficiency note](./token-efficiency.md) measured 1.6× to 3× on a single case. Read the suite producer total as the signal, and the per-case token column as a range.

Other full-suite producer totals on `main` since the covering-skeleton work, one run each, same model. Steps exist only where the harness recorded them. These commits are all after 0.8.0 and before or at `94cb448`. They show the band a single run already occupies.

| Run | Commit | Producer tokens | Producer steps | Notes |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| 0.8.0, this report | `4167e5f` | 2,776,563 | 21 | release skill and CLI |
| [35552579760](https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende/actions/runs/35552579760) | `da6ebeb` | 2,551,962 | | checks failed on 5 cases |
| [35580729835](https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende/actions/runs/35580729835) | `18bd5cb` | 2,687,144 | | passed |
| [35647787903](https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende/actions/runs/35647787903) | `a05aef8` | 3,287,719 | | passed, last run before the batched skill |
| [35712133164](https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende/actions/runs/35712133164) | `d796524` | 2,865,944 | 16 | same skill tree as `main`, one size expect missed |
| [35730203593](https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende/actions/runs/35730203593) | `94cb448` | 2,653,514 | 14 | this report's `main` |

The `main` producer total (2.65M) sits inside that band (2.55M to 3.29M). The step drop (21, then 16 on the same skill as `main`, then 14) is the stable change. A second `main` run could move the token total by as much as the cases above already do.

The [token efficiency note](./token-efficiency.md) used a separate stream script and reported a 4.51M producer mean. That series is a different counter. This report uses the eval harness on both sides.
